Strict Zero-Broker Policy

Real estate brokers, commercial leasing agencies, property agents, property aggregators, and unauthorized middlemen are categorically forbidden. Any profile suspected of acting as a commercial broker or operating sub-leasing networks will be permanently banned with forfeited paid tokens and zero appeal recourse.

Flatrimony interfaces strictly through certified, audited verification partners. We retrieve and retain only verified legal full name, date of birth, gender, and a non-reversible cryptographic hash validating document authenticity. We never inspect, store, or warehouse raw national identity documents, biometrics, or identification numbers.
Single Identity Rule:

Flatrimony strictly enforces a 'One Person, One Account' governance rule. Maintaining burner accounts, creating parallel profiles using third-party credentials, or falsifying your employer or educational biodata will lead to immediate, irrevocable suspension across your device footprint.
Every room posting, flat share invitation, or pre-lease co-application created on Flatrimony must adhere strictly to factual integrity and radical financial transparency.
True monthly cost:

Every listing must publish the inclusive True Monthly Cost. This mandatory total must account for base room rent, society maintenance charges, regular shared cook and domestic staff dues, Wi-Fi subscriptions, estimated electricity splits, and mandatory clubhouse levies. Omitting fixed overheads or introducing surprise expenses during site visits is a breach of our Community Code.
Unedited Video Walkthroughs:

Room vacancy postings require real, continuous, and unfiltered video walkthroughs documenting authentic bedroom natural daylight, bathroom water pressure, and true ambient street acoustic levels. Staged real-estate stock renders, architectural mockups, or heavily filtered promotional assets are flagged and purged.
Zero Tolerance on Brokerage:
No brokerage, finder's cut, sub-lease markup, or administrative fee may ever be demanded, levied, or settled through Flatrimony.
Your real-world safety is our utmost structural priority. We establish strict operational guardrails surrounding in-person viewings and tenancy monetary transactions.

NEVER send advance booking tokens, holding deposits, key reserves, or advance rental payments over UPI or bank wire before executing an in-person physical viewing and reviewing the landlord's registered title deed or primary tenancy agreement.
